notes: Multi Studio version 2.1.39: **Unified Selector System**: Upgraded Model Version, Instruction Preset, and Director's Note dropdown selectors to a cohesive UI design featuring radio circle indicators, active selection borders, and dark mode popovers., **Smart Preset Lifecycle**: Instruction Preset selectors automatically resolve active project preset names, dynamically update when saving or editing presets, and safely handle deleted presets without errors., **Contained Sidebar Dropdowns**: Rebuilt Director's Note dropdowns using Radix UI Portals with smart alignment (start, center, end) to prevent dropdown popups from overflowing past sidebar boundaries., **Readable Option Descriptions**: Replaced single-line text truncation with natural multi-line text wrapping on Director's Note style and pace descriptions., **Fixed Option Scrolling**: Eliminated scroll jitter and stutter inside option lists by streamlining Radix Viewport scroll engines and optimizing repaint performance., **Unblocked Block Deletion**: Fixed script block deletion event bubbling so you can delete any block anytime when it is not actively rendering.
